summary: OddOneGaming showcases three high-performing teams for the Crown Contest Lightning Guardian boss, achieving over 7 billion total damage across three rounds. The guide highlights an Aura team doing ~3.2B damage, a Toxin team doing ~1.9B damage, and a Corrosion team doing ~2.1B damage. Detailed equipment sets, hero stat priorities, and artifact synergies are explained for each composition. Key mechanics include using healers with Gatekeeper's Staff to turn overhealing into shields and teamwide damage buffs, as well as optimizing attack order and stat thresholds for maximum ultimate energy gains.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Requires the highest Attack and Crit Damage in the team so Shahla and Lincos target her with their ultimate energy and stat buffs.

heroes.name: Shahla
heroes.note: Uses the Destiny's Will talent to continuously grant ultimate energy and Aura energy to Talethia when her ultimate bounces.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Equipped with Witch's Remains artifact to consistently inflict defense penalties on the boss targets.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Wears Puppeteer's Inspiration set to speed up ultimate rotation for same-element allies, with recast timing set to 15s if needed.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Provides healing and team damage buffs using Moonlight's Grace and Devout Prayer sets; can be substituted with Solmo, Acilia, or Rena.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Equipped with Gatekeeper's Staff, Moonlight's Grace, and Devout Prayer to convert overhealing into team shields and damage buffs.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Wears Puppeteer's Inspiration and Golden Antlers; can be replaced by other poison appliers like Corrin.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Built full damage with Statue of the Serpent Deity artifact to maximize poison derivative damage.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Wears Ilhuya's Fang, Whirling Edge, and Bardic Inspiration weapon to maximize poison debuff landing and damage output.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.note: Uses Misty Conch and Bardic Inspiration weapon to help maintain debuff uptime while providing team utility.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Built with Golden Alarm artifact and near 100% Crit Rate for strong AoE damage output.

heroes.name: Whisk
heroes.note: Built full damage with Swamp Toadstool artifact to maximize Corrosion derivative damage.

heroes.name: Calavera
heroes.note: Uses Gatekeeper's Staff to convert overhealing into shields, triggering Secrecy Order's Chant and Devout Prayer team buffs.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.note: Built with 100% Crit Rate and Puppeteer's Inspiration to supply extra ultimate energy to Corrosion allies.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Equipped with Misty Conch, Sacred River's Revelation, and Moonlight's Grace to provide healing and damage amplification.

teams.note: Achieves ~3.2B damage; relies on Shahla feeding ultimate energy to Talethia while Lincos wears Puppeteer's Inspiration.
Achieves ~1.9B damage; relies on Oggok overheal shielding to maintain team buffs while Serpentemis and Twitch deal massive Toxin damage.
Achieves ~2.13B damage; high-investment Corrosion composition using Calavera's overhealing to trigger shield-activated team damage buffs.

tips: Ensure your main Aura DPS (Talethia) has the highest Attack stat on the team so single-target Attack-based buffs land on her instead of supports.
Equip high-volume healers like Oggok and Calavera with Gatekeeper's Staff alongside Devout Prayer or Secrecy Order's Chant to turn overhealing into shields that grant teamwide damage buffs.
Include at least one hero wearing the Puppeteer's Inspiration set in elemental teams to feed ultimate energy to same-element allies.
Golden Tresym is the preferred familiar for multi-target boss encounters to increase AoE damage taken by enemies.
If missing specific Toxin or Corrosion legendaries, substitute with your best AoE damage compositions in Burn (Durem), Thunderbolt, Rally, or Dauntless.
